map.结果可以用于案件吗？: Can this result be used in casework?
map.不能。初始体温、衣着和环境会影响冷却，实际降温并非恒速；本工具无法量化误差。: No. Initial temperature, clothing and environment affect cooling, which is not constant; this tool cannot quantify error.
map.假定初始温度 37°C、恒定降温速率 0.83°C/h；无法量化误差，不提供置信: Assumes an initial temperature of 37°C and a constant cooling rate of 0.83°C/h. Error cannot be quantified and no confidence interval is provided. Corneal observations are not converted into time.
map.t = (37 − Tr) / 0.83，以 37°C 和每小时 0.83°C: t = (37 − Tr) / 0.83 assumes 37°C initially and a cooling rate of 0.83°C/h. Actual cooling varies with the individual, clothing and environment; this illustration cannot provide a reliable error range.
